prettybeaches.configuration.title: Pretty Beaches
prettybeaches.configuration.affectedBloc: List of blocks that should be affected by the adjusted water physics. If you want to have all blocks affected, just include "*" in the list.
prettybeaches.configuration.infiniteBuck: Whether buckets should be able to retrieve infinite water without destroying sources as well.
prettybeaches.configuration.animatedFloo: Whether the flooding of adjacent air blocks should be animated or instant.
